baselines.dyad_base_rate: br from train counts; collapses to global rate for unseen dyads
baselines.markov_recency: logistic on active, since_act, log_n_act; C tuned on select
baselines.per_dyad_markov: train transition counts per directed dyad, +2 prior; collapses to global transition for unseen dyads

secondary_warm_history.why: the train-only per-dyad baselines are degenerate on a unit holdout; warm-history versions use only observed history available at prediction time, not holdout labels

calendar_specs.S1_primary: frozen t_yr = t_idx/12, linear extrapolation as in P1; this is the pre-registered primary because it is the exact frozen feature contract.
calendar_specs.S2_sensitivity: t_yr clipped at 238/12 (2014-11, last train month), a no-extrapolation calendar encoding motivated by the 2026-10-23 methodology review; pre-registered before the holdout run.
calendar_specs.year_fe_anchor: year dummies 1996..2014 with 2014 carried forward for 2015+; used as a feature-group anchor, not as the primary model.

definition.algorithm: pairs sorted by (min(sid,tid),max(sid,tid)); rng=default_rng(seed); for stratum in (1,0): idx=rng.permutation(n); k=max(1,floor(frac*n+0.5)); take idx[:k]
definition.strata: ever_active_in_pre_embargo_train (max(active)=1 for any month with t_idx<239); second stratum = never active
definition.universe: all unordered actor pairs with >=1 row in the frozen 1995-01..2023-04 dyad-month panel

embargo.handling: drop from train/select/eval; recompute br from the remaining train rows; graph features are not rebuilt for the embargo because they use edges at <=t, not the row's label.
embargo.rationale: the label at month t is activity at t+1; the last month of a period labels the next period. Dropping the boundary row removes the one-month label leak.

endpoints.mde: paired MDE at 80% power, alpha=0.05, dyad-clustered; also baseline-variance MDE as a conservative reference
endpoints.no_selective_ci: all four clustering views are reported for the primary contrast; no dyad-only claim

feature_sets.note: exact frozen P1 contract: 27 causal + br + seen_tr = 29; +20 graph core features = 49. No feature is added or removed after seeing the holdout.

definition.algorithm: pairs sorted by (min(sid,tid),max(sid,tid)); rng=default_rng(seed); for stratum in (1,0): idx=rng.permutation(n); k=max(1,floor(frac*n+0.5)); take idx[:k]
definition.strata: ever_active_in_pre_embargo_train (max(active)=1 for any month with t_idx<239); second stratum = never active
definition.universe: all unordered actor pairs with >=1 row in the frozen 1995-01..2023-04 dyad-month panel

inference.auc_ap: full holdout, no subsample; 1,000 cluster-bootstrap reps for the primary comparison; 1 seed for secondary comparisons, 5 seeds for LL/ECE
inference.claim_rule: report dyad/source/target/actor-two-way/multiway CIs together; if the multiway CI includes 0, do not claim an accuracy improvement (SR-F7); if the gain is <2% relative, label it exploratory.
inference.multiway: max(Var_source + Var_target - Var_dyad, Var_source, Var_target, Var_dyad); dyad is the source-target intersection, so this is also the three-way dyad+source+target interval
inference.paired: one bootstrap weight vector applied to base and model

models.capacity_control: HGB49 with 2x3 lr x leaves grid (max_iter 120, refined 80/160/200 if at edge)

paper_scope.claim: binary dyadic event prediction + source/target actor exact additive explanations + stability audit; no node-level prediction, no lifecycle causal claim
paper_scope.period: 2018-01..2022-11 retrospective; unit-fresh 20% unordered-dyad holdout; not a time-fresh test

splits.eval: 276 <= t_idx < 335 (2018-01..2022-11), holdout dyads only, embargo row 335 removed
splits.select: 240 <= t_idx < 251 (2015-01..2015-11), holdout dyads removed, used for C / HGB / calibration
splits.train: t_idx < 239, holdout dyads removed, t_idx not in embargo

stopping_rules.SR-F1: no fresh holdout -> no confirmatory abstract (this run satisfies it by unit freshness)
stopping_rules.SR-F7: multiway CI includes 0 -> framework/audit claim only
stopping_rules.gain_lt_2pct: report as exploratory, not a headline accuracy claim

test_policy.burn: 2018-22 is retrospectively burned by earlier G2/D2/B runs; the holdout is unit-fresh, not time-fresh.
